adaptedFiles.changes: Keep regular running applications, bundle ID and application-path lookup; add activation, camelCase output and omit absent bundle identifiers.

Retain and compare visited accessibility identities to skip cycles and duplicate proxy subtrees within an observation. Discover focused and nested AppKit sheets as independently selectable windows. Preserve window-discovery AX failures and return empty scoped trees only when the requested app-owned CG window has no matching AX surface.
Recognize nested AXSheet window IDs and exclude sibling sheets and menu bars from sheet-scoped observations.
Post each background mouse event once through SkyLight, using the public PID-targeted API only when the private API is unavailable.

Send press_key chords through authenticated PID-targeted modifier transitions, with reverse-order cleanup and implicit Shift for plus. Preserve existing single-key and Unicode typing paths. Original upstream file SHA-256: 77de9f1600ade692c9c923c8bfb24e7cb59581a345188f113cb93705138ab493.
